description: Source code for a command-line tool 'bindesc' that works with binary descriptors, including functions for parsing, searching, and converting binary descriptor data, as well as handling different file formats and external dependencies.

classes.name: Bindesc
classes.description: A command class for working with binary descriptors, supporting dump, search, and list operations, and handling various file formats.

methods.name: convert_from_uf2
methods.description: Converts a UF2 binary buffer into raw binary data, handling magic numbers, addresses, and padding.

methods.name: do_add_parser
methods.description: Adds command-line argument parsers for subcommands like dump, search, custom_search, and list.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Reads binary image data and dumps all binary descriptors found.

methods.name: common_search
methods.description: Performs a search for a specific descriptor in the binary image.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a descriptor by name.

methods.name: custom_search
methods.description: Searches for a custom descriptor by type and ID.

methods.name: do_run
methods.description: Executes the command based on parsed arguments, handling dependencies and file processing.

methods.name: get_image_data
methods.description: Reads binary data from a file, supporting various formats like bin, hex, elf, uf2.

methods.name: parse_descriptors
methods.description: Parses binary descriptors from image data based on magic number and format.

methods.name: guess_file_type
methods.description: Guesses the file type based on extension or magic headers.

methods.name: bytes_to_uint
methods.description: Converts bytes to unsigned integer considering endianness.

methods.name: bytes_to_short
methods.description: Converts bytes to short integer considering endianness.

methods.name: bindesc_gen_tag
methods.description: Generates a binary descriptor tag from type and ID.

methods.name: bindesc_get_type
methods.description: Extracts the type from a descriptor tag.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns an index to the specified byte boundary.

methods.name: bindesc_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a descriptor value.
